				limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = omni_library_scroll_stock target = flag:scroll_eptelonian_poetry_8 } NOT = { has_variable = omni_scroll_read_eptelonian_poetry_8 } treasury >= 60 }
				add_treasury = -60
				set_variable = omni_scroll_read_eptelonian_poetry_8
				add_research = { technology = civic_tech value = 1 }
				remove_list_variable = { name = omni_library_scroll_stock target = flag:scroll_eptelonian_poetry_8 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = omni_library_scroll_stock target = flag:scroll_eptelonian_poetry_9 } NOT = { has_variable = omni_scroll_read_eptelonian_poetry_9 } treasury >= 120 }
				add_treasury = -120
				set_variable = omni_scroll_read_eptelonian_poetry_9
				add_research = { technology = oratory_tech value = 1 }
				remove_list_variable = { name = omni_library_scroll_stock target = flag:scroll_eptelonian_poetry_9 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = omni_library_scroll_stock target = flag:scroll_eptelonian_poetry_10 } NOT = { has_variable = omni_scroll_read_eptelonian_poetry_10 } treasury >= 60 }
				add_treasury = -60
				set_variable = omni_scroll_read_eptelonian_poetry_10
				add_research = { technology = civic_tech value = 2 }
				remove_list_variable = { name = omni_library_scroll_stock target = flag:scroll_eptelonian_poetry_10 }
			}
		}
	}
}
